levels.name: Lift shaft
levels.sol: r7(F)
levels.start: F F F F F F F
levels.hint: So many Forwards! Can one Repeat do the same job?

levels.name: Long corridor
levels.sol: R r6(F) L F
levels.start: R F F F F F F L F
levels.hint: Keep the turns as they are. Which part could one Repeat squash?

levels.name: Two long halls
levels.sol: r4(F) R r5(F)
levels.start: F F F F R F F F F F
levels.hint: Each straight line can have its own Repeat. Count the squares!

levels.name: Three streets
levels.sol: r3(F) L r3(F) R r4(F)
levels.start: F F F L F F F R F F F F
levels.hint: Three straight lines and two turns. How short can you make it?

levels.name: Wide stairs
levels.sol: r3(F F L F R)
levels.start: F F L F R F F L F R F F L F
levels.hint: Find the chunk of blocks that comes again and again.

levels.name: Stairs and a hall
levels.sol: r3(F L F R) r4(F)
levels.start: F L F R F L F R F L F R F F F F
levels.hint: Two jobs: climb the stairs, then walk the hall. A Repeat for each!

levels.name: Shepherd's crook
levels.sol: r3(F F R F)
levels.start: F F R F F F R F F F
levels.hint: Cut the list into equal chunks. The last chunk may be cut short!

levels.name: Magnet
levels.sol: r3(r4(F) R)
levels.start: F F F F R F F F F R F F F F
levels.hint: Three sides, each a line and a turn. Can a Repeat hold a Repeat?

levels.name: Lightning bolt
levels.sol: r2(r3(F) L r3(F) R)
levels.start: F F F L F F F R F F F L F F F
levels.hint: Find one giant step, then make each line inside it short too.

levels.name: Garden rake
levels.sol: r3(r2(R F F R) F F)
levels.start: r2(R F F R) F F r2(R F F R) F F r2(R F F R) F F
levels.hint: One tine and a walk come three times. What can hold them all?

levels.name: Over the hill
levels.sol: r2(r3(F L F R) F R)
levels.start: r3(F L F R) F R r3(F L F R)
levels.hint: Both staircases use the same blocks. Can one Repeat do them both?

levels.name: Roller coaster
levels.sol: R r2(r2(F F L) r2(F F R))
levels.start: R F F L F F L F F R F F R F F L F F L F F
levels.hint: Each dip turns the same way twice at the bottom. Spot more repeats!

levels.name: Pond patrol
levels.sol: f f f|F F R F F
levels.start: F F R F F F F R F F F F R F F|F F R F F
levels.hint: F1 is built already, but nobody uses it! Where do its blocks appear?

levels.name: Zigzag cliff
levels.sol: f f f|F R F F L F
levels.start: F R F F L F F R F F L F F R F F L F
levels.hint: The same piece comes three times. Build it once in F1!

levels.name: Peekaboo
levels.sol: f F f R f F|F L F R R F L
levels.start: F L F R R F L F F L F R R F L R F L F R R F L F
levels.hint: The robot peeks into every nook the same way. Even the last one?

levels.name: Three flights
levels.sol: f F f R f|r2(F R F L)
levels.start: r2(F R F L) F F R F L F R F L R F R F L F R F
levels.hint: One flight is shrunk already. Are the other flights the same piece?

levels.name: Bendy pipe
levels.sol: f F f R f R r4(F)|F F R F L F
levels.start: F F R F L F F F F R F L F R F F R F L F R F F F F
levels.hint: Three bends that match, then a long straight. Use F1 and a Repeat!

levels.name: Snake trail
levels.sol: r2(f R F) f L f|F R F L r2(F)
levels.start: F R F L F F R F F R F L F F R F F R F L F F L F R F L F F
levels.hint: F1 can go inside a Repeat. Which uses of F1 come with the same turn?

levels.name: Spiral staircase
levels.sol: f F F r2(L f)|F r2(F L F R)
levels.start: f F F L f L f|F F L F R F L F R
levels.hint: Both rows are too long. Look for a repeat in F1 and one in the program.

levels.name: Grand spiral
levels.sol: f F r3(f L)|F r2(F L F R)
levels.start: F r2(F L F R) F F r2(F L F R) L F r2(F L F R) L F r2(F L F R)
levels.hint: Four flights, one piece. What comes between the flights each time?
